Concentration correlation heatmap (advanced_plots)

Source: R/resultsExplorer_plots.R
re_plot_heatmap_correlations.Rd

Z-scored sample x metabolite heatmap, capped at 200 samples and 100 metabolites to keep file size reasonable (matches Shiny limits). Mirrors the Shiny results_heatmap.

Usage

re_plot_heatmap_correlations(
  data,
  metabolites = NULL,
  max_samples = 200,
  max_metabolites = 100
)

Arguments

data

Data frame.

metabolites

Optional character vector. Defaults to all numeric columns (minus metadata).

max_samples, max_metabolites

Integer caps.

Value

list(static, interactive), or NULL.
